description_en: Queries Express Connect traffic QoS rules. This operation does not support pagination parameters
description_zh: 调用DescribeExpressConnectTrafficQosRule查询高速通道QoS规则，不支持分页参数
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-express-connect-traffic-qos-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --rule-id-list qos-rule-iugg0l9x27f2no0000 --rule-name-list qos-rule-test --qos-id qos-2giu0a6vd5x0mv0000 --queue-id qos-queue-9nyx2u7n71s2rc0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeExpressConnectTrafficQosRule

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the QoS policy.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
